tei:div.tei:p: Blessed be He who spoke so that the world came into being, blessed be He who speaks and acts, blessed be He who decrees and fulfils, blessed be He who has mercy on the earth, blessed be He who has mercy on the creatures, blessed be He who grants those that fear Him a good reward, blessed be He who lives forever and exists for eternity, blessed be the Redeemer and Deliverer, blessed be His Name. Blessed art Thou, O Lord our God, King of the World, God the merciful father who is praised by the mouth of His people, extolled and glorified by the tongue of His devoted ones and His servants. Through the songs of David Thy servant will we praise Thee, O Lord our God, with songs of praise and hymns will we magnify Thee, praise Thee and glorify Thee and recall Thy Name and crown Thee as our King, our God, unique and everlasting, the King whose great Name is extolled and glorified for ever. Blessed art Thou, O Lord King celebrated in paeons of praise.
